verses.1: I will lift up mine eyes unto the mountains: From whence shall my help come?
verses.2: My help cometh from Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.
verses.3: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: He that keepeth thee will not slumber.
verses.4: Behold, he that keepeth Israel Will neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.5: Jehovah is thy keeper: Jehovah is thy shade upon thy right hand.
verses.6: The sun shall not smite thee by day, Nor the moon by night.
verses.7: Jehovah will keep thee from all evil; He will keep thy soul.
verses.8: Jehovah will keep thy going out and thy coming in From this time forth and for evermore.

metadata.source: Derived from the American Standard Version (1901), revised for the ABIDE Bible App.
